name: snipe-it-lite-frontend-tests
description: Regression tests for the frontend's vanilla-JS module wiring -- catches the class of bug where main.js (loaded as a single <script type="module"> on every page) fails to import/link because a named export it expects (e.g. from components/users.js) doesn't actually exist. That failure is silent in the browser except for one symptom: EVERY page's JS dies at load time, so nothing (including the login form's submit handler) ever gets wired up, and forms silently fall back to native browser submission -- e.g. the login form reloading to a bare 'index.html?' instead of calling the API. See login-form-wiring.test.mjs.
